class.name: OcgXcafprsAisobject
class.brief_description: Implements AIS_InteractiveObject functionality for shape in DECAF document.
class.description: ! Implements AIS_InteractiveObject functionality for shape in DECAF document.

method.name: XCAFPrs_AISObject
method.description: Creates an object to visualise the shape label.

method.name: GetLabel
method.description: Returns the label which was visualised by this presentation

method.name: SetLabel
method.description: Assign the label to this presentation (but does not mark it outdated with SetToUpdate()).

method.name: DispatchStyles
method.description: Fetch the Shape from associated Label and fill the map of sub-shapes styles. By default, this method is called implicitly within first ::Compute(). Application might call this method explicitly to manipulate styles afterwards.

method.name: SetMaterial
method.description: Sets the material aspect. This method assigns the new default material without overriding XDE styles. Re-computation of existing presentation is not required after calling this method.
